
## Install

1. Download **Mitra-for-MirAIe-<version>.dmg** below, open it, and drag **Mitra for MirAIe** into
   **Applications**.
2. Open it from Applications. macOS says it can't verify the app, because it isn't signed with a
   paid Apple Developer ID. Click **Done**, open **System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security**, scroll
   down to **Security** and click **Open Anyway** next to "Mitra for MirAIe was blocked". You'll
   need to do this again after each update.
3. Click the AC icon in the menu bar and sign in with your MirAIe mobile number or email.

Requires macOS 26 or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. Downloaded builds don't include the
widgets and Control Center toggle; build from source with your own Apple developer team to get
them.
